spans.s:
रुश् {c6c} P. (रुशति)
1 To hurt, kill,
destroy.
--2 To tease, vex.

रुष् {vI.v} {c4c} P. (रुस्यति; rarely रुष्यते;
रुषित, रुष्ट) To be angry, to be vexed
or annoyed, be offended; ततोऽ
रुष्यदनर्दच्च

; मा मुहो मा रुषोऽ
धुना 15. 16, 9. 20. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (रोषति)
1 To hurt, injure, kill.
--2 To vex,
annoy.
--3 Ved. To be offended.
--Caus. To provoke, engage,
exasperate.

रुष्, रुषा f. Anger, wrath, rage;
निर्बंधसंजातरुषा

रूष् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (रूषति, रूषित)
1 To
adorn, decorate.
--2 To smear,
anoint, cover, overlay (as with dust).
{vII.v} {c10c} U. (रूषययि-ते)
1 To tremble.
--2 To burst.

रुशत् a.
1 Hurting, disagreeable,
displeasing (as words).
--2 Ved.
Bright, white.

रुष्, रुषा f. Anger, wrath, rage;
निर्बंधसंजातरुषा

रुषित, रुष्ट p. p. Angry, enraged,
provoked.

रूषित p. p.
1 Adorned.
--2
Smeared, covered, overspread.
--3 Soiled.
--4 Made rough or rugged.
--5
Pounded.
--6 Perfumed.
--7 Inlaid.

रुषित, रुष्ट p. p. Angry, enraged,
provoked.
